Furthermore, the above applies only to n rather than to PD(n): it relies on the barrier constructed using Theorem III.4, which uses a nontrivial strengthening of the self-concordance estimates for the squared distance. We expect that such a strengthening can also be obtained more generally, and this would immediately generalize the algorithmic result from Theorem VI.1 to these spaces; we also leave this as a problem for future work.
